// diagnostic E0347

Jet.InvalidMetaCategory

`#Meta` category is not plain quoted text

What

`#Meta` category is not plain quoted text

Why

Tooling shows the category as a label, so it must be fixed text written in quotes

Fix

Use a plain quoted string for the `#Meta` category.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InvalidMetaCategory: Tests/UI/meta_category_nonplain_e0347.stderr.

Error: Jet.InvalidMetaCategory: `#Meta` category needs plain quoted text
  --> meta_category_nonplain_e0347.jet:3:21
    |
  3 |     #Meta(category: "a{tag}")
    |                     ^^^^^^^^
 Why: `category` is compile-time tooling data, not a runtime string
 Fix: Write a string literal, e.g. `category: "Movement"`
